description: Demolition of existing buildings and erection of four enclosed padel courts one external padel court, a single storey building, provision of new access gates, car parking, refuse and cycle stores and associated landscaping.
subdivision_of_building: The proposal is to split the site in two with half staying as the plant centre containing a greenhouse and ancillary buildings. The other half proposed to be padle tennis courts. Our client's proposal is to demolish one of the greenhouses, portacabin, timber building & storage container.
